TRADE_MARKET_SLIPPAGE_CAP_BPS.note: Worst price a market buy may be funded at above the best ask.

TRADE_CANCEL_ALL_AFTER_SWEEP_INTERVAL_MS.note: One second sweep so journeys finish fast.

TRADE_FEE_SCHEDULE.note: Zero fee schedule, spot and perpetual, so the order paths post no fee. Without the perpetual block futures orders refuse.

TRADE_COLLATERAL_HAIRCUT_BPS.note: Cash in the settle asset counts in full, so futures opens are held only by their margin.

TRADE_COPY_FEE_SHARE_LAW.note: The fee share D26-P0-02 published in .env.example: 10% of the trading fee on copied orders, capped at 1000 per follower, halved after 50 round trips.

TRADE_COPY_JURISDICTION_LAW.note: TEST fixture, never a product default (ADR 2026-08-12: test fixtures may use codes). Counsel has supplied no list, so live stays blank and refuses. US is left off so a refusal can be seen.

TRADE_COPY_METRIC_DEFINITIONS.note: What a lead page's return and drawdown mean. Win rate and Sharpe ratio stay undefined, so they read Not set.

TRADE_COPY_MIN_TIER.note: TEST verification level for copying: full, the level the journeys verify to, so an unverified account is refused.

TRADE_OTC_DESK_LAW.note: TEST quote desk law: 20 bps disclosed spread, a 100 IFC stake floor (J-copy-bots-otc-24 stakes it; one below it is refused), the platform as counterparty, a 60 s firm quote so a journey sees one expire, a reference price trusted for one day (the stack's boot-stamped TEST mid), and a 60 s window to settle an accepted quote so a journey sees one close.

TRADE_OTC_MIDS.note: TEST reference price for the quote desk: the TEST BTC/USDT book's start price on the local stack, stamped at boot. Not a market price.
